textos.A divergência central está na qualidade: The central divergence is in the quality of the script: most of those who do not recommend it point to weaknesses in the writing and narrative development, while most of those who recommend it praise the story and highlight the cast's work.
textos.Muitas reviews reclamam que o termo raci: Many reviews complain that the racial term is repeated to exhaustion, making scenes uncomfortable and purposeless.
textos.O filme é descrito como arrastado, com q: The film is described as dragging, with nearly three hours that seem endless and moments of boredom.
textos.Algumas pessoas sentem que a escravidão: Some people feel that slavery is used as a backdrop for stylized violence, coming across as exploitative and disrespectful.
textos.O arco do caçador de recompensas branco: The white bounty hunter's arc is seen as centralizing, overshadowing the Black protagonist's journey.
textos.Direção inadequada para a temática: Direction unsuited to the subject matter
textos.A escolha de um diretor branco para cont: The choice of a white director to tell this story is criticized as inappropriate and disconnected from the Black experience.
textos.Roteiro fraco e falta de desenvolvimento: Weak script and lack of development
textos.O enredo é considerado previsível, com d: The plot is considered predictable, with weak dialogue and underdeveloped characters.
textos.Várias reviews medianas reclamam que o f: Several middling reviews complain that the film is too long, with dragging stretches that make the experience tiring, and that the running time could be cut without loss.
textos.Este grupo critica o uso exagerado de sa: This group criticizes the exaggerated use of blood and violent scenes, considering them unrealistic and tiring, although some acknowledge this is part of the director's style.
textos.As atuações são frequentemente elogiadas: The performances are often praised, especially those of Christoph Waltz and Leonardo DiCaprio, but some point out that Jamie Foxx gets little prominence or that certain characters are one-dimensional.
textos.Tom e equilíbrio entre humor e brutalida: Tone and balance between humor and brutality
textos.Há comentários sobre a dificuldade de eq: There are comments on the difficulty of balancing humor and brutality, resulting in an uneven tone that oscillates between the comic and the shocking, which undermines the seriousness of some moments.
textos.Algumas reviews questionam a forma como: Some reviews question the way slavery is portrayed, feeling that it serves more as a backdrop for revenge than as a theme explored in depth, and mention the excessive use of racist terms.
textos.Este grupo debate se o filme é uma homen: This group debates whether the film is an effective homage or a collage of references, with some finding that it lacks originality and that the director leans too heavily on his own clichés.
textos.As reviews positivas destacam repetidame: Positive reviews repeatedly highlight the performances of Christoph Waltz, Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx and Samuel L. Jackson, considering them one of the film's strongest points.
textos.Este grupo enaltece a marca autoral do d: This group praises the director's authorial mark, with long dialogue, stylized violence and film references that make the film unmistakable.
textos.As reviews positivas elogiam a seleção m: Positive reviews praise the music selection, which fits the scenes perfectly and contributes to immersion in the western.
textos.Este grupo destaca a qualidade visual do: This group highlights the film's visual quality, with striking framing, detailed sets and a convincing recreation of the Old West.
textos.As reviews positivas apontam a estrutura: Positive reviews point to the well-defined three-act structure, the progression of the characters and the building of an engaging, satisfying plot.
textos.Este grupo menciona a violência exagerad: This group mentions the exaggerated violence and the shootout sequences as fun, characteristic elements of the work.
textos.aprecia atuações marcantes e expressivas: appreciate striking, expressive performances from a standout main cast
textos.busca uma assinatura autoral com diálogo: look for an authorial signature with extended dialogue, references and stylized violence
textos.gosta de uma seleção musical envolvente: enjoy an engaging music selection that intensifies the western mood
textos.se diverte com sequências de tiroteio mo: have fun with lively shootout sequences and exaggerated graphic violence

textos.rejeita o tratamento da escravidão como: reject the treatment of slavery as a backdrop for violent entertainment
textos.Lançado em 2012 e dirigido por Quentin T: Released in 2012 and directed by Quentin Tarantino, Django Unchained is a drama and western. The story presents a slave bought by a bounty hunter to assist him on a mission and who, after this initial partnership, sets out to rescue his wife from her owner.
textos.A experiência cinematográfica é estrutur: The cinematic experience is structured around a long-running narrative set in the historical context of slavery, marked by long dialogue sequences and frequent scenes of stylized graphic violence.
textos.De maneira geral, os grupos concordam so: Overall, the groups agree on what the film is and disagree in their verdict on how well those choices work. Among the vast majority of ratings (~92%), practically all praise the performances of the main cast. About half of this set extols Tarantino's signature and characteristic style, while a significant share highlights the soundtrack and sound.
textos.Por outro lado, sob a perspectiva observ: On the other hand, from the perspective observed in a minimal fraction of ratings (~7%), a good portion stress that the excessive running time and slow pace make the work drag. A considerable number criticize the excessive violence and the cartoonish style adopted, although a smaller slice acknowledge positive aspects in the cast's performance.
textos.Por fim, para quem se posiciona numa fra: Finally, for those in an even smaller fraction of ratings (~1%), several express strong discomfort with the excessive use of racist language. In addition, many point to the slow pace and excessive running time as flaws, and a significant share condemns the exploitation of slavery as entertainment.
